source: 240-case E2E suite (v1 60 + v2 40 + v3 140, per the suite header) against a local gateway running HEAD, measured 2026-09-28 before and after the D11-L5 taxonomy-tag fix
notes: collapse_rate = decided cases whose candidate pool fell back (fallback_used). The 0.05 floor is tolerance, not aspiration: fallback_used also fires when the pool is legitimately empty (all models unavailable), which is a healthy outcome and must not fail a build, so zero is rejected by validateE2EBaseline. Headroom is 12 of 240 cases — the gate passes at exactly 12 and fails at 13. Before the D11-L5 fix the rate was 12/240 = 0.0500, all of it task_type=code_audit, because TaskVocabularyRepresented substring-matched taxonomy tags: the live library's family:codex / family:codegemma / family:starcoder2 / version:codestral-latest all contain the substring 'code', so a model family NAMED codex asserted that the code/review/security capability vocabulary existed. That skipped the absent-vocabulary neutralisation, left MatchScore at 0 on the top candidate, and tripped the 48h popularity collapse guard — collapsing code_audit from 3 candidates to 1 (composite=50, quality=0, tier empty). isCapabilityTag now restricts presence to the cap: namespace (plus bare tags); after the fix the same 240 cases measure 0/240 = 0.0 with classification accuracy unchanged at 240/240. Only evaluated when -e2e-report is supplied — the offline classification gate cannot compute it.
